Effort is quantified in team output — "You're producing 2 static graphics/month... roughly 1 creative every 15 days" versus "closer to 8-15 new video-native assets/month" required. The two-person ceiling is stated explicitly and drives the conclusion: "Two people making 2 static graphics/month cannot feed that machine."
